page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.s2 family. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 2 physical cores, resulting in 1.0 thread per core. The instance is provisioned with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage. There are no integrated GPUs, and the instance does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

A key technical characteristic of the ecs.s2.large is the absence of advanced CPU instruction sets. Hardware flags for Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX-512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and cryptographic acceleration (AES, SHA_NI) are not available. This lack of vector and matrix acceleration limits its efficiency for mathematical modeling, cryptography, and machine learning workloads.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a low resource footprint, this instance represents an entry-level tier for workloads requiring predictable CPU performance without high memory demands. It is suitable for lightweight applications, basic web serving, small utility scripts, and development environments that do not require advanced instruction sets or local storage.
